respuesta.pregunta: I'm sizing a client against catalog-portfolio-api 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a. What performance targets does the service declare in terms of latency, throughput and availability, and how does it handle its database connections?
respuesta.respuesta:
The architecture guide for catalog-portfolio-api 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a gives these performance characteristics:

- Latency: under 100 ms for typical operations [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L114-L114].
- Throughput: 1000+ requests per second [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L115-L115].
- Availability: a 99.9% uptime SLA [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L116-L116].
- Database connections: pooled, with circuit breakers [catalog-portfolio-api/0.0.1-test-bench-v2a/guide/architecture/README.md:L117-L117].
